title: Data associated with "Magnetic order and novel quantum criticality in the strongly interacting quasicrystals"
description: Numerical data supporting the results presented in the main text and Supplemental Material of the manuscript "Magnetic order and novel quantum criticality in the strongly interacting quasicrystals". The data are organized into the main_data and SM_data directories. Additional details concerning the data format and Binder-ratio conventions are provided in the README file.
